headword: {一抹|いちまつ}の{不安|ふあん}
gloss: a touch of anxiety; a slight unease

definitions.gloss: a touch of anxiety; a slight unease; a lingering worry
definitions.explanation: A faint but persistent feeling of worry or concern. The word {一抹|いちまつ} means "a trace" or "a touch," so the expression conveys a small but nagging sense of unease.

examples.japanese: {一抹|いちまつ}の{不安|ふあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a touch of anxiety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{一抹|いちまつ}の{不安|ふあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The plan is going well, but a slight unease remains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦やれる→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧{一抹|いちまつ}の{不安|ふあん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Along with excitement about the new job, there was also a slight worry about whether I could do well.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{一抹|いちまつ}→一抹：09074_ichimatsu⟧ literally means "one stroke" (of a brush), evoking the image of a thin, faint line. The expression is semi-literary and often appears in written Japanese, news articles, and formal speech. It conveys worry that is small but cannot be dismissed.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一抹|いちまつ}の{不安|ふあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel a touch of anxiety)
- {一抹|いちまつ}の{不安|ふあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (a slight unease remains)
- {一抹|いちまつ}の{不安|ふあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to sense a slight unease)
- ⟦{一抹|いちまつ}→一抹：09074_ichimatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寂|さび}しさ (a touch of loneliness — ⟦{一抹|いちまつ}→一抹：09074_ichimatsu⟧ can modify other feelings too)
